pieces.blurb: A landing craft run up on the sand, its ramp down (local north) and its well open: cover to fight from and through, beach obstacles and spilled crates round it. It never moves.

notes.design: The craft is 10.7 m long and 3.3 m wide (sized to an LCVP), collides as voxels (its well, ramp and gunwales as modelled: walk up the ramp into the well, shoot over the sides).
